author: GaryMarcus
text:
AI is an elite crime spree. 

From copyright violations to hacking to monopolization to sex trafficking, the companies behind AI violate the law. The problem isn't a lack of regulations, it's that the law doesn't apply to the powerful. 
 https://www.thebignewsletter.com/p/ai-is-an-elite-crime-spree
